meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 分析蛋白质糖基化:扫描 N-糖基化位点(N-X-S/T),预测 O-糖基化热点,提供糖基化位点突变建议,并可引用 NetOGlyc、GlycoShield 等外部工具辅助分析。
howto.when: 当用户提供蛋白质序列并要求分析糖基化,或涉及抗体工程、疫苗设计、治疗性蛋白优化等场景时。

say.text: 帮我找这段序列里的 N-糖基化位点,并列出位置和序列。
say.note: Claude 会扫描并返回位点列表。

say.text: 预测这条蛋白的 O-糖基化热点。
say.note: 基于局部 S/T 密度进行启发式预测。

say.text: 把 IgG1 Fc 的 N297 突变成 Q,消除糖基化。
say.note: 会调用函数进行定点突变。

howto.what_en: Analyze protein glycosylation: scan for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, suggest glycosite mutations, and reference external tools like NetOGlyc and GlycoShield.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides a protein sequence and asks for glycosylation analysis, or in contexts such as antibody engineering, vaccine design, or therapeutic protein optimization.

say_en.text: Find N-glycosylation sites in this sequence and list their positions and motifs.
say_en.note: Claude scans and returns the site list.

say_en.text: Predict O-glycosylation hotspots for this protein.
say_en.note: Uses a heuristic based on local S/T density.

say_en.text: Mutate N297 to Q in the IgG1 Fc to remove the glycosylation site.
say_en.note: Calls a function to perform the point mutation.
